name: Docker Manager
description: Engine status, containers, images, volumes and Compose projects in one place: start, stop, restart, inspect logs, prune and install Docker Engine on the NAS. The engine helper and the /api/docker endpoints stay in EthOS because the package runtime depends on them; this package is the desktop app.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.4: show authorization errors clearly and report pull/prune progress while requests run. 1.0.3: scope actions and data lookups to each Docker Manager window; remove global inline handlers. 1.0.2: window redesigned with the shared AntiVirus/Domains shell — 218 px rail with text-only nav, summary tiles, one simple table per section and an engine panel that states the next step; dialogs use the shared modal. 1.0.1: Package Center icon redrawn on the 256 px grid; requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. The Docker Manager desktop app moves out of the core install; the Docker Engine helper, the compose runtime and the /api/docker endpoints stay in EthOS because every container package depends on them.
